name: exp027b_paired_padded_pilot250
notes: EXP-027b LOCAL end-to-end pilot (not a registered test): 250 m reference, 500 m main, 2 km control; 2 draws x 12 cases (seeds 1101-1102; cases are the first 12 of the corresponding 48-case draws, because draw_cases is sequential in its rng). Proves the pipeline and gives one real 250 m data point for the power analysis; far too small to be a test.
